reason: Old ContentRazorHelperExtensions methods are marked Obsolete but kept as thin wrappers delegating to the new global-namespace ContentOrchardHelperExtensions, preserving backward compatibility, though the csproj now references the full ContentManagement project (transitive dependency change) which could subtly affect assembly loading for consumers.
